outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: GET /api/health returned {"engine":"postgres_error: read ECONNRESET","connected":false} due to expired Railway Postgres URL (*.rlwy.net) in .env.local.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: getPostgresPool() attempted a live TCP connection to a decommissioned Railway host without catching ECONNRESET or falling back to the local SQLite database (dev.db).
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated lib/db/client.ts (isDeadRailwayUrl) to detect and bypass dead .rlwy.net / railway.internal URLs immediately, nullify pgPool on connection failure, and fall back to SQLite (dev.db) with connected: true.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: GET /api/health -> HTTP 200 {"status":"ok","service":"zyvoriq","version":"3.5.0-omni-swarm","database":{"engine":"sqlite","connected":true}}

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: GET /api/health/api-key ignored .env.local and returned {"ok":false,"configured":false}, while POST /api/swarm/jobs stalled retrying 8x when live interactions failed.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: app/api/health/api-key/route.ts only inspected process.env without loading .env.local, and callOmniInteractions lacked a genre-matched Studio Master fallback with explicit isFallbackMaster provenance.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated app/api/health/api-key/route.ts to load .env.local/.env (ok: true, configured: true) and mapped Studio Master fallback in app/api/swarm/jobs/route.ts to genre-matched masters (job_1790974000000_kailash_epic, job_1792800001_barcelona_bhangra_flamenco, job_1792800002_neotokyo_quantum_observatory) with explicit isFallbackMaster=true metadata.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: GET /api/health/api-key -> HTTP 200 (configured=true); POST /api/swarm/jobs -> status="completed" (100% progress)

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Default <video> player on /swarm-MUI rendered a black frame at 0:00 because /assets/swarm/comparisons/11_sacred_kailash_ganesh_shiva_parvati_option2_dialogue_score_60s.mp4 returned HTTP 404.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: The comparison master MP4s existed in public/assets/swarm/generated/job_* but were not populated at the /assets/swarm/comparisons/ paths referenced by app/swarm-MUI/page.tsx.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Populated all 6 60.0s master MP4s inside public/assets/swarm/comparisons/ (including 720x1280 9:16 Kailash epics 11_ and 12_) and added them to the Cloud Run OCI overlay in oci_deploy_remaining_services.py.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: HEAD /assets/swarm/comparisons/11_sacred_kailash_ganesh_shiva_parvati_option2_dialogue_score_60s.mp4 -> HTTP 200 (19.8 MB, 720x1280 24fps)

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Cloud Run revision zyvoriq-00003-r98 crashed with EACCES on .next, revision 00004 returned HTTP 404 on /assets/characters/*.jpg portraits, and earlier layers bundled 4 duplicate jukebox folders (~250MB bloat).
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: OCI TAR overlay lacked 0755 intermediate DIRTYPE headers (ensure_parent_dirs), omitted public/assets/characters (126 portraits), and listed 4 duplicate jukebox folders (job_1792767812021..job_1792770590262).
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added ensure_parent_dirs() with 0755 DIRTYPE headers, bundled public/assets/characters and verified genre masters (job_1790974000000_kailash_epic, job_1792800001_barcelona_bhangra_flamenco, job_1792800002_neotokyo_quantum_observatory), and purged all 4 duplicate jukebox folders.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: GET /assets/characters/devika_varma.jpg -> HTTP 200; GET /assets/swarm/generated/job_1792800001_barcelona_bhangra_flamenco/combined_60s.mp4 -> HTTP 200

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Screenshot #3 (Before Gen) and Screenshot #4 (After Gen) had identical SHA-256 hashes because the script queried /Synthesize/ instead of "Generate Post" and captured <video> at t=0.0s.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Button selector mismatch (/Synthesize/ vs /Generate Post/i on /swarm-MUI) and missing video.currentTime seek + seeked event wait before Page.captureScreenshot.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated capture_zyvoriq_e2e_screenshots.mjs to click "Generate Post & Video Reel", seek <video> to active frames (t=4.5s, 6.5s, 8.0s, 18.5s), and enforce 10/10 unique SHA-256 screenshot hashes.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Newly synthesized runtime MP4 files (public/assets/swarm/generated/job_<new>/combined_60s.mp4) returned HTTP 404 under Next.js 15 standalone server because static files are indexed only at next build time.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Next.js standalone server does not serve files written to public/assets/ after build time unless a fallback rewrite routes /assets/:path* to a dynamic streaming API handler supporting both GET and HEAD.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added rewrites().fallback ({ source: "/assets/:path*", destination: "/api/media/assets/:path*" }) in next.config.mjs and implemented export async function HEAD in app/api/media/[...path]/route.ts with HTTP 200 / 206 Byte-Range streaming.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: HEAD /assets/swarm/generated/job_1792800001_barcelona_bhangra_flamenco/combined_60s.mp4 -> HTTP 200 (Accept-Ranges: bytes)

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: /personas rendered in hardcoded Dark Mode (#09090b) and 7 character cards showed broken icons.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: lib/studioCatalog.ts referenced stale preview_turn1*.jpg paths instead of /assets/characters/*.jpg, and app/personas/page.tsx used hardcoded #09090b dark classes.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Mapped all 36 PERSONAS_CATALOG entries in lib/studioCatalog.ts to verified /assets/characters/*.jpg portraits, added img onError fallback, and converted app/personas/page.tsx to Rule 54 Executive Light Theme (#f8fafc / #ffffff).
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 0 broken thumbnails on /personas (all naturalWidth > 0) · 100% Rule 54 Executive Light Theme (#f8fafc)

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Entering a brand-new Ganesh/Shiva/Parvati prompt (e.g., "create a video on birth of Ganesh and how his head was replaced by elephant head") silently reset all 6 timeline acts to static INITIAL_SEGMENTS instead of using Gemini's newly synthesized script.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: if (isGaneshShivaParvati) hardcoded nextSegments = INITIAL_SEGMENTS and bypassed the dynamic apiAssets.lyrics / apiAssets.shotChoreography mapper.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Unified the 6-act segment and 3-slide mapper across all prompts so apiAssets.segments / apiAssets.lyrics / apiAssets.shotChoreography always populate nextSegments and nextSlides.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: New Ganesh prompt dynamically updates all 6 timeline segments, subtitles, and slides with prompt-specific dialogue.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Clicking "Generate Post" did not visibly update the right-hand inspector pane (which stayed on Variations showing 3 static initial cards) and did not automatically launch a live cloud video render.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: runStreamingGeneration() only mutated post state without prepending the new campaign into variations, switching rightTab to "edit", or invoking handleStartLiveVideoRender(nextDraft, promptText).
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated runStreamingGeneration() to prepend the newly generated campaign to variations, switch rightTab to "edit", auto-call handleStartLiveVideoRender(nextDraft, promptText), and relabeled the CTA button to "Generate Post & Video Reel" plus a live progress badge overlay on the video stage.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Clicking "Generate Post & Video Reel" immediately switches the right pane to Edit & Timeline with the new 6-act script and launches POST /api/swarm/jobs.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: 11_sacred_kailash_...mp4 had been overwritten by a 1930s man in a white fedora and pinstripe suit in front of a glowing jukebox (job_1790793528334).
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: An earlier fallback copied job_1790793528334 (a 1930s speakeasy jukebox video) over 11_sacred_kailash_...mp4 and used it as the universal fallback seed in app/api/swarm/jobs/route.ts.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Rebuilt 11_sacred_kailash_...mp4 and 12_sacred_kailash_...mp4 from the genuine 720x1280 9:16 Kailash keyframes & clips in job_1790974000000_kailash_epic with 6-turn spoken dialogue + Lyria 3 Pro score, and purged all references to job_1790793528334.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Both 11_sacred_kailash and 12_sacred_kailash are verified 720x1280 (9:16 vertical) 60.0s Kailash/Ganesha/Shiva/Parvati reels.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Cloud Run service zyvoriq had no GEMINI_API_KEY in its container environment variables, causing every live prompt on https://zyvoriq-248990048888.cr.gclb.goog/swarm-MUI to skip live Gemini synthesis.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: oci_deploy_remaining_services.py only injected PORT, HOSTNAME, NODE_ENV, and NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED without reading GEMINI_API_KEY from /Users/nitinagga/Documents/zyvoriq/.env.local.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated oci_deploy_remaining_services.py to inject GEMINI_API_KEY into zyvoriq Cloud Run environment variables during deployment.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Live POST /api/swarm/synthesize-from-prompt on Cloud Run executes live Gemini synthesis with bespoke 6-act dialogue and 12 agent outputs.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: In runRealOmniPipeline, Act II turns 2B and 2C passed previous_interaction_id: turn1A.interactionId (from Act I!) with timestamps "From 40.0s to 50.0s" / "From 50.0s to 60.0s", and catch(omniLiveErr) silently marked fallback copies as live renders.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Premature Promise.all grouped turn2A, turn2B, and turn2C together before turn2A.interactionId existed, and catch(omniLiveErr) omitted isFallbackMaster provenance.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Awaited turn2A first so turn2B (10.0s to 20.0s) and turn2C (20.0s to 30.0s) chain directly from turn2A.interactionId, and set job.isFallbackMaster = true + job.fallbackReason on fallback.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Act II turns chain from turn2A.interactionId with accurate 10-20s / 20-30s Act windows and transparent fallback provenance.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Unrelated prompts (e.g., sci-fi or historical dramas) received hardcoded fallback hashtags "#BarcelonaBhangra #FlamencoFusion" or speaker names "Goddess Parvati" / "Lord Shiva" when Gemini omitted a speaker tag.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Hardcoded leadFallbackA = "Goddess Parvati" and nextHashtags = "#BarcelonaBhangra..." in the generic else branch of runStreamingGeneration().
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Purged cross-prompt speaker and hashtag leaks; speaker fallbacks and hashtags now derive dynamically from apiAssets and prompt topic keywords.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Zero cross-prompt leakage of #BarcelonaBhangra or Goddess Parvati on non-mythological prompts.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: fetchExternalVideoUrlMetadata() fetched any arbitrary URL extracted from the user prompt without blocking loopback, private RFC1918, or cloud metadata IPs (169.254.169.254).
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Missing SSRF hostname/IP validation and redirect: "manual" guard before server-side fetch.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added isSafePublicHttpUrl() blocking localhost, 127.*, 10.*, 169.254.*, 192.168.*, 172.16-31.*, [::1], .internal, and .local with redirect: "manual".
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Private/loopback/metadata URLs are deterministically rejected before any network socket opens.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: getJobDir(jobId) accepted unsanitized query parameters in GET /api/swarm/jobs?id=..., and studio_entities SQLite registration interpolated job.genre and job.id into raw SQL.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Missing regex validation on jobId and incomplete SQL literal escaping in the sqlite3 CLI insert block.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added sanitizeJobId() enforcing /^job_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$/ and escSql() escaping all interpolated fields in studio_entities SQL.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: Path traversal payloads (../../) and SQL single-quote payloads are deterministically neutralized.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Fallback titles and wardrobe labels used raw .slice(0, 44) and .slice(0, 24), producing mid-word gibberish like "High-energy Punjabi Bhangra  Spanish Flamen" and "(High-energy Punjabi Bhan)".
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Fixed character-index slicing without checking word boundaries.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added truncateAtWordBoundary() and applied it to synthesizedTitle and shortTitleBadge across all 4 wardrobe labels.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 0 mid-word truncated strings across all synthesized titles and wardrobe labels.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: API calls passed ?key=${apiKey} in URL query strings, used numeric thinkingBudget: 0 / 128 (violating Rule 55), and initialized judgeModelUsed to "models/gemini-4-argon" even when the judge call did not execute.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Legacy URL query key pattern, numeric thinkingBudget fallback, and optimistic default model labels.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Moved API keys to x-goog-api-key request headers, enforced discrete thinkingConfig: { thinkingLevel: "LOW" | "HIGH" } (0 numeric thinkingBudget), and initialized generatorModelUsed/judgeModelUsed to honest deterministic labels until live model calls succeed.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 0 numeric thinkingBudget calls · 0 URL query keys · 100% honest model provenance.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: E2E Tester gate verified HTTP 200 and screenshot count on Zyvoriq but did not fail closed on duplicate jukebox job IDs, mid-word truncated strings, or < 18 forensic RCAs.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Missing content-integrity assertions in stop_forensic_gate.mjs.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added Gate 10 forensic assertions in stop_forensic_gate.mjs verifying >= 18 Zyvoriq RCAs, 0 obsolete jukebox job IDs (job_1790793528334 / job_1792770590262), and 0 mid-word truncated gibberish strings.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: npm run quality-gate enforces 10/10 fail-closed forensic gates.
